text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali and Belgian Foreign Minister Eric Derijcke agree to ease visa procedures for Moroccans.
- France's Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine expected in Morocco late in July.
- Election of members of prefectoral and provincial assemblies starts.
- France's ambassador in Rabat says his country plans to extend number of visas to Moroccans to 100,000 annually from current 60,000 in two years.
- Dissidents of Socialism and Progress Party (SPP) attack their former party local headquarters in northern city of Nador.
